description_zh: 获取漏洞修复统计数据
name: DescribeVulFixStatistics

parameters.help_en: The ID of the member accounts in the resource folder. The member accounts are Alibaba Cloud accounts. You can invoke the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to query this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
资源目录成员账号ID（阿里云账号）。
调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id

FixStat.description_en: The list of vulnerability fix statistics information
FixStat.description_zh: 漏洞修复统计信息列表

sys: Windows vulnerability
cms: Web-CMS vulnerability
app: Application vulnerability
emg: Emergency vulnerability
